🚨 Traffic Advisory 🚨

Due to pole work on the PVNR Expressway, commuters travelling from RGIA towards Mehdipatnam are advised to use the New Upparpally Ramp, as the main landing and Shivrampally Ramp are temporarily closed.

🚗 In addition, vehicular movement from Mehdipatnam towards RGIA is moving slowly as traffic is restricted to a single lane due to GHMC road-marking painting work near Pillar No. 305 on PVNR Road towards RGIA.

⚠️ Commuters are requested to plan their travel accordingly and expect delays on this stretch.

#TrafficAdvisory #TrafficAlert #HyderabadTraffic #PVNRExpressway #DriveSafe
